answer_to_user: Note on method: there is no direct price-to-free-cash-flow field, so I screened its exact inverse — FCF yield (free cash flow ÷ market cap) — and took the TOP 10% tail, which is identically the CHEAPEST 10% on P/FCF. Ranked across a broad global-tech universe of 4,203 names, the bottom decile is 80 stocks. The cheapest legitimate names (very high FCF yield = very low P/FCF) include Truly International (0732.HK, ~2.2x-equivalent, 33% FCF margin), Upland Software (UPLD.US), Wooree Bio (082850.KQ), Nanjing Sample Technology (1708.HK), SiS International (0529.HK), Cliq Digital (CLIQ.XETRA), iomart Group (IOM.LSE) and MarketWise (MKTW.US). One CAVEAT: the #1 row (Core AI Holdings, CHAI.US) actually has NEGATIVE free cash flow, which the yield math flips into a spurious high number — ignore it; a true low-P/FCF screen needs positive FCF, which the rest of the list has.
